metadata.scope: Apple-branded devices and product-family categories across all years discoverable through iFixit English categories, teardown guides and selected linked articles; excludes third-party accessories and Beats.
metadata.completeness: Best-effort text inventory, not a certified exhaustive inventory of all Apple hardware or every chip in iFixit images, PDFs, videos, comments, repair guides or news articles.
method: Enumerated Apple product branches in the public category hierarchy and fetched 639 category pages.
Cross-checked all 2,114 entries returned by the global public teardown index.
Fetched teardown and Chip ID guides associated with Apple categories, with supplemental title-based discovery.
Extracted written chip/component identifications; reviewed extraction exceptions and selected linked teardown articles.
Grouped entries by the guide device category. Identical identification strings are deduplicated within that category, retaining all source occurrences.

interpretation.chips: Textual chip-identification entries, not unique chip packages or quantities. An entry may name multiple components, a stacked package, a module, a sensor, a marking alone, or a function with no part number.
interpretation.manufacturers_mentioned: Names mentioned in the identification, not a verified manufacturer or foundry attribution.
interpretation.tentative: True when tentative wording appears in the extracted identification. False does not mean independently verified.
interpretation.empty_chips: No identification extracted in this scan; does not imply the device contains no chips or iFixit never identified them.
interpretation.category_has_children: True means iFixit lists descendant categories; it does not necessarily mean the record is only a product family.
interpretation.variants: Specifications and identifiers refer to the source units. Do not assume all storage sizes, regional models or revisions use the same chips. Combined-device teardown titles remain assigned to their source category.

excluded_material: New OCR or visual inference from board photos
Third-party source pages linked by iFixit

attribution.license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, subject to source-specific notices
attribution.changes: Factual extraction, grouping, deduplication and selected condensation of chip descriptions. Original narrative and images are not reproduced.
